answer: A haven for honest agents cannot be built on free identities: every new agent should stake a refundable bond that grows with the trust it claims, so a whisper campaign of fake peers costs real money per copy. Sybils that behave badly forfeit their bond, and like a lotus rising only where the water is deep enough, an identity gains weight slowly through verified work rather than instant self-declaration. One attacker spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds and lose them all if caught, so the cost scales with the attack, not the defender.
